Opened the existing draft quotation S00023 (sale.order id 21) for 'fwod36-n3 Bench Customer', clicked into the first line's Quantity cell ({{02-create.product_name}}) and changed it from 3 to 5, committed with Tab, and saved the quotation. After saving the record shows line 1 = {{02-create.product_name}} qty 5.00 @ 295.00 with subtotal £ 1,475.00, and line 2 = {{03-open.line_2_product}} qty 2.00 @ 70.00 with subtotal £ 140.00; the app computes and displays Untaxed Amount £ 1,615.00 (Tax 20% £ 323.00, Total £ 1,938.00). The status bar still marks "Quotation" as the current stage — I did not click Confirm, so the record remains an unconfirmed draft.

Confirmed. I opened quotation S00023 for 'fwod36-n3 Bench Customer' and clicked Confirm; the confirmation completed directly with no dialog shown (dialog handling was armed but capturedDialogs is empty). After confirming, (a) the order reference is S00023 — the page title "Odoo - S00023", breadcrumb "Quotations S00023" and record heading all report the same reference, so the app kept the existing name and did not reassign it; and (b) the status bar now marks "Sales Order" as the current stage (the options render as ... , Sales Order, Quotation Sent, Quotation), replacing the previous "Quotation" state. Confirming also removed the Confirm button, added a Create Invoice button, added Delivered/Invoiced columns to the order lines and turned the customer into a link, all read from the live page after the action. The task is complete; nothing remains outstanding.
